## Unparented

### Detect sequence groups for the automatic file order; unrelated files stay rarest-first

`proposed` · `@templartorrent.work.sequence-group-detection/1`

Close the sequence-group detection gap of DESIGN.md section 4. The automatic order treated every torrent as a sequence in natural name order. Now grouping::automatic finds one name template differing in one or two numeric runs (S01E01, Disc 1/01, part1, .part01.rar, .r00), orders members outer run first with ties by the natural comparator and wire index, schedules sidecars after their member, and otherwise claims nothing: one tier of equally ranked files, which the picker takes rarest-first. The Sequence carries tiers (files sharing a rank), the session, driver, job record and persistence carry tier starts, the UI's Automatic order asks the driver for the detected order, and shared ranks are labelled.
